articles.summary: ROANOKE, Va. (June 29, 2026)—The Board of Directors of RGC Resources, Inc. (Nasdaq: RGCO) declared a quarterly dividend of $0.2175 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend will be paid on August 3, 2026 to shareholders of record on July 17, 2026. This is the Company’s 329th consecutive quarterly cash dividend. RGC Resources,
articles.title: RGC Resources, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
